# Peregrin

> Peregrin (peregrin.travel) sells genuine, verifiable flight reservations that travellers use as proof of onward or return travel for visa applications, immigration and airline check-in. Each reservation is a real booking held with the airline in the traveller's name, with a booking reference (PNR) anyone can check on the airline's own website. It is not a purchased ticket: no airfare is charged, and the reservation lapses under the fare's own terms unless the traveller chooses to pay for the flight.

Current status (November 2026): new flight reservations are paused while Peregrin adds a new airline partner. Travellers can join the launch waitlist on peregrin.travel and get 20% off when reservations reopen.

## What it costs

- One-way reservation: US$14.99, flat fee
- Return reservation: US$19.99, flat fee
- No airfare is charged unless the traveller later decides to confirm and fly

## How verification works

- The reservation exists in the airline's own booking system, so an embassy, immigration officer or check-in agent can look up the booking reference directly with the airline.
- Peregrin also offers a verification page: https://www.peregrin.travel/verify
- Peregrin never sells edited or made-up PDFs. What forums call a "dummy ticket" is, done properly, a real held reservation like this one.
